observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor illuminated stage at night with palm trees and a Maldives promotional display in the background
observation.dancers: A group of men, performing solo in turns and together
observation.formation_and_space: Musicians stand in a line on the raised stage; dancers move freely on the lower ground area in front of the stage
observation.posture: Torso upright with a tendency to bend forward from the waist during energetic movements, knees slightly bent
observation.footwork: Stepping and stamping barefoot in time with the drums, occasional low lunges and quick weight shifts
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing and gesture fluidly, hands open or clenched loosely, matching the rhythm of the music
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle hip movement and forward torso inclination during deep knee bends
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low levels with deep knee bends, occasional drops to a squat, and quick spins
observation.costume_and_props: Matching dark polo shirts and striped sarongs (feyli) worn by musicians and dancers
observation.cannot_infer: Low resolution makes precise footwork and subtle weight transfers difficult to observe in detail.

signature_moments.what: Dancer bends knees deeply with arms extended outwards while stamping rhythmically
Dancer crouches low, moving sideways with rapid stepping and arm swings
